nodes.label: FAULT F36.1 — Build-Order Fault at Runtime Rebuild
nodes.rationale: The runtime layer copy was split into two loops instead of strict 19→35, so rt/frachf_S.jsonl took pack33's single row instead of pack34's six; t7c_corrz.py ended at the latest pack only by luck of order. Repair: copy packs in strict numeric order, and check each rt file against its LATEST pack copy.

nodes.label: The Byte Census Admits a Match to Any Pack
nodes.rationale: Because the census accepts a match against any pack, an out-of-date pack copy passes as OK — the R 1671 shape, where the instrument narrows its own input. The fault was caught only because gate 61 recomputed instead of skipping and appended a row to the wrong file.
